name: local_ele_fashion_cuda
deviations: Full single-domain Ele-fashion node schedule; not the paper's joint-pretraining protocol.
Feature order is explicitly assumed and not yet independently verified.
PPR alpha/epsilon, optimizer defaults, temperature and seed batch size are implementation assumptions.
Windows Python 3.9.13 / torch 2.1.2 cu118 / DGL 1.1.2 differ from the paper server stack.
No downstream test labels are used during pretraining. A CLI max-steps override makes this a limited-budget run.
Explicit max gradient norm=1.0 prevents huge zero-embedding normalization gradients; this is an engineering adaptation absent from the disclosed paper settings.
